title: Swiss Chard and Leek Pie
subtitle: with ricotta, mint and dill
description: A crustless pie of massaged chard, golden leek, ricotta, mint and dill set with eggs and a little wholemeal flour. Massaging the chard with salt keeps its fresh green flavour while stopping it from releasing too much liquid in the oven.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and grease a baking tin with oil.

Cut the chard leaves into 1/2 cm strips and soak in plenty of cold water for 10 minutes. Drain, sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt (still in the colander) and massage with your hands for 2 to 3 minutes until soft and releasing liquid.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the finely chopped leek for 7 to 9 minutes over medium heat until golden and soft. Remove from the heat, add the chard and mix.
Whisk the eggs with the flour and ricotta in a bowl. Add the chard and leek, mint, dill, chilli, salt and pepper and mix well. Transfer to the tin.
Brush the top of the pie with 2 tablespoons olive oil.

Bake for about 30 minutes until browned and dry to the touch (check after 25 minutes, as ovens vary). Place a plate over the tin, flip to release the pie, then flip it back onto a serving plate. Serve hot or at room temperature.
